-- Enable RLS on tables
alter table public.accounts enable row level security;
alter table public.files enable row level security;
alter table public.file_shares enable row level security;

-- Helper function: check if current user is suspended
create or replace function public.is_current_user_suspended()
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
as $$
  select coalesce(
    (select suspended from public.accounts where user_id = auth.uid()),
    false
  );
$$;

-- Helper function: check if user can edit a file
create or replace function public.can_edit_file(file_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.files f
    where f.id = can_edit_file.file_id
    and f.owner_id = auth.uid()
  ) or exists (
    select 1 from public.file_shares fs
    where fs.file_id = can_edit_file.file_id
    and fs.shared_with = auth.uid()
    and fs.can_edit = true
    and (fs.expires_at is null or fs.expires_at > now())
  );
$$;

-- Helper function: check if user can read a file
create or replace function public.can_read_file(file_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.files f
    where f.id = can_read_file.file_id
    and f.owner_id = auth.uid()
  ) or exists (
    select 1 from public.file_shares fs
    where fs.file_id = can_read_file.file_id
    and fs.shared_with = auth.uid()
    and (fs.expires_at is null or fs.expires_at > now())
  );
$$;

-- Accounts policies
create policy "accounts_select_own"
  on public.accounts
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid() and not public.is_current_user_suspended());

-- Files policies
create policy "files_select_owner"
  on public.files
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (owner_id = auth.uid() and not public.is_current_user_suspended());

create policy "files_select_shared"
  on public.files
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    not public.is_current_user_suspended()
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.file_shares fs
      where fs.file_id = files.id
      and fs.shared_with = auth.uid()
      and (fs.expires_at is null or fs.expires_at > now())
    )
  );

create policy "files_insert_own"

  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (owner_id = auth.uid() and not public.is_current_user_suspended());

create policy "files_update_own"

  for update
  to authenticated
  using (owner_id = auth.uid() and not public.is_current_user_suspended())
  with check (owner_id = auth.uid() and not public.is_current_user_suspended());

create policy "files_update_shared_edit"
  on public.files

  for select
  to authenticated

-- R2: Users can revoke their own active keys
create policy "Users can revoke their own active keys"
  on public.api_keys
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid() and revoked_at is null)
  with check (user_id = auth.uid() and revoked_at is not null);

-- Prevent any other updates via trigger
create or replace function public.check_api_key_update()
returns trigger as $$
begin
  -- Only allow update if only revoked_at is changing
  -- and the key was not already revoked
  if old.revoked_at is not null then
    raise exception 'Cannot modify a revoked key';
  end if;
  
  if old.id is distinct from new.id or
     old.user_id is distinct from new.user_id or
     old.name is distinct from new.name or
     old.key_hash is distinct from new.key_hash or
     old.last4 is distinct from new.last4 or
     old.created_at is distinct from new.created_at then
    raise exception 'Only revoked_at can be modified on api_keys';
  end if;
  
  return new;
end;
$$ language plpgsql security definer;

  before update on public.api_keys

    -- Clients: must own project, and not internal

-- Helper function to check if a purchase order is decided
create or replace function public.is_po_decided(po_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select exists(select 1 from public.po_approvals where po_approvals.po_id = $1);
$$;

-- Helper function to check if user is an approver
create or replace function public.is_approver(user_id uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select exists(select 1 from public.approvers where approvers.user_id = $1);
$$;

-- Helper function to get approver limit
create or replace function public.get_approver_limit(user_id uuid)
returns numeric(12, 2)
language sql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  select coalesce((select limit_amount from public.approvers where approvers.user_id = $1), 0);
$$;

-- ============================================
-- POLICIES FOR public.purchase_orders
-- ============================================

-- R1: Requesters can see their own purchase orders. Approvers can see every purchase order.
create policy "purchase_orders_select"
  on public.purchase_orders
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    requester_id = auth.uid()
    or public.is_approver(auth.uid())
  );

-- R2: Users can create purchase orders as themselves
create policy "purchase_orders_insert"
  on public.purchase_orders
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    requester_id = auth.uid()
  );

-- R2: Users can edit their own purchase orders until they are decided
create policy "purchase_orders_update"
  on public.purchase_orders
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (
    requester_id = auth.uid()
    and not public.is_po_decided(id)
  )
  with check (
    requester_id = auth.uid()
  );

-- R2: Users can delete their own purchase orders until they are decided
create policy "purchase_orders_delete"
  on public.purchase_orders
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (
    requester_id = auth.uid()
    and not public.is_po_decided(id)
  );

-- ============================================
-- POLICIES FOR public.po_approvals
-- ============================================

-- R4: Requesters can see decisions on their own POs; approvers can see every decision
create policy "po_approvals_select"
  on public.po_approvals
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    exists(select 1 from public.purchase_orders where purchase_orders.id = po_approvals.po_id and purchase_orders.requester_id = auth.uid())
    or public.is_approver(auth.uid())
  );

-- R3: Approver can record a decision as themselves if amount within limit and they didn't request it
create policy "po_approvals_insert"
  on public.po_approvals
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    approver_id = auth.uid()
    and public.is_approver(auth.uid())
    and not exists(
      select 1 from public.purchase_orders
      where purchase_orders.id = po_id
      and purchase_orders.requester_id = auth.uid()
    )
    and exists(
      select 1 from public.purchase_orders
      where purchase_orders.id = po_id
      and purchase_orders.amount <= public.get_approver_limit(auth.uid())
    )
    and not public.is_po_decided(po_id)
  );

-- ============================================

-- ============================================

grant select, insert on public.po_approvals to authenticated;
grant select on public.approvers to authenticated;

revoke all on public.po_approvals from anon;
revoke all on public.approvers from anon;

grant execute on function public.is_po_decided(bigint) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.is_approver(uuid) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.get_approver_limit(uuid) to authenticated;

-- Helper function: check if user can read a folder (owns or has grant on folder or any ancestor)
create or replace function public.can_read_folder(folder bigint, uid uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
  with recursive ancestors as (
    select f.id, f.parent_id, f.owner_id
    from public.folders f
    where f.id = folder
    union all
    select f.id, f.parent_id, f.owner_id
    from public.folders f
    join ancestors a on f.id = a.parent_id
  )
  select exists (
    select 1 from ancestors
    where owner_id = uid
    union all
    select 1 from ancestors a
    join public.folder_grants g on g.folder_id = a.id
    where g.user_id = uid
  );
$$;

-- Enable Row Level Security on tables
alter table public.workouts enable row level security;
alter table public.workout_sets enable row level security;

-- Revoke all from anon and authenticated, then grant back selectively
revoke all on public.workouts from anon, authenticated;
revoke all on public.workout_sets from anon, authenticated;

grant select, insert, update, delete on public.workouts to authenticated;
grant select, insert, update, delete on public.workout_sets to authenticated;

-- Helper function to check if current user owns a workout
create or replace function public.is_workout_owner(p_workout_id bigint)
returns boolean
language plpgsql
security definer
as $$
begin
  return exists (
    select 1 from public.workouts
    where id = p_workout_id
    and user_id = auth.uid()
  );
end;
$$;

-- Helper function to get workout owner from set id
create or replace function public.get_workout_owner_from_set(p_set_id bigint)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
security definer
as $$
declare
  v_workout_id bigint;
begin
  select workout_id into v_workout_id
  from public.workout_sets
  where id = p_set_id;
  
  return (
    select user_id from public.workouts
    where id = v_workout_id
  );
end;
$$;

-- Policies for public.workouts

-- R1: Users can read only their own workouts
create policy "Users can read own workouts"
  on public.workouts
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

-- R1: Users can create their own workouts (user_id defaults to auth.uid())
create policy "Users can create own workouts"
  on public.workouts
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (user_id = auth.uid());

-- R1: Users can edit only their own workouts
create policy "Users can update own workouts"
  on public.workouts
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid())
  with check (user_id = auth.uid());

-- R1: Users can delete only their own workouts
create policy "Users can delete own workouts"
  on public.workouts
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

-- Policies for public.workout_sets

-- R2: Users can read sets of their own workouts
create policy "Users can read sets of own workouts"
  on public.workout_sets
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (public.is_workout_owner(workout_id));

-- R2: Users can add sets to their own workouts, never to others' workouts
create policy "Users can insert sets into own workouts"
  on public.workout_sets
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (public.is_workout_owner(workout_id));

-- R2: Users can edit sets of their own workouts, never move to others' workouts
create policy "Users can update sets of own workouts"

create policy "Users can delete sets of own workouts"

  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (public.is_workout_owner(workout_id));

  on public.workouts

  to service_role
  using (true)
  with check (true);

create policy "Service role full access on workout_sets"
  on public.workout_sets
  for all

  using (true)
  with check (true);

  );
$$;

returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
as $$

    select 1 from public.jobs
    where id = jid and customer_id = auth.uid()
  );

  on public.mechanics
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true);

  on public.jobs
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (customer_id = auth.uid());

  on public.jobs
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (public.is_mechanic_of_garage(garage_id));

  on public.jobs
  for insert

  );

  on public.jobs

  )

    where household_id = p_household_id
      and user_id = auth.uid()
  );
end;

returns bigint as $$

  on public.household_members
  for select

    select 1 from public.household_members hm2
    where hm2.household_id = household_members.household_id
      and hm2.user_id = auth.uid()
  ));

create policy "members can add members to their household"

  on public.shopping_items

  to authenticated

  on public.shopping_items
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    public.is_household_member(household_id)
    and added_by = auth.uid()
    and claimed_by is null
    and is_bought = false
  );

create policy "members can claim unclaimed items for themselves"
  on public.shopping_items
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (
    public.is_household_member(household_id)
    and (
      -- claim an unclaimed item
      (claimed_by is null and (select claimed_by from shopping_items where id = shopping_items.id) is null)
      -- unclaim their own claimed item
      or (claimed_by = auth.uid() and (select claimed_by from shopping_items where id = shopping_items.id) = auth.uid())
      -- mark as bought (only claimed_by can do this, and can only change is_bought to true)
      or (
        (select claimed_by from shopping_items where id = shopping_items.id) = auth.uid()
        and is_bought = true
        and (select is_bought from shopping_items where id = shopping_items.id) = false
        and (select claimed_by from shopping_items where id = shopping_items.id) is not null
      )

      or (claimed_by is null and (select claimed_by from shopping_items where id = shopping_items.id) = auth.uid() and is_bought = false)

      or (claimed_by = (select claimed_by from shopping_items where id = shopping_items.id) and claimed_by = auth.uid() and is_bought = true)
    )
  );

-- R2, R3: break_glass function
create or replace function public.break_glass(p_patient_id bigint, p_reason text)
returns timestamptz
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_expires_at timestamptz;
  v_trimmed_reason text;
begin
  -- Check caller is a clinician
  if not exists (select 1 from public.clinicians where user_id = auth.uid()) then
    raise exception 'Caller is not a clinician';
  end if;

  -- Check patient exists
  if not exists (select 1 from public.patients where id = p_patient_id) then
    raise exception 'Patient does not exist';
  end if;

  -- Check reason length (ignoring surrounding spaces)
  v_trimmed_reason := trim(p_reason);
  if length(v_trimmed_reason) < 10 then
    raise exception 'Reason must be at least 10 characters';
  end if;

  -- Create grant
  v_expires_at := now() + interval '1 hour';
  
  insert into public.break_glass_grants (patient_id, clinician_id, reason, expires_at)
  values (p_patient_id, auth.uid(), v_trimmed_reason, v_expires_at);

  return v_expires_at;
end;
$$;
